{{DISPLAYTITLE:Summon Magic (''Tactics Advance'')}}
{{Quote|Summoner command. Summon creatures from the ether.|Description}}
'''Summon Magic''' {{J|召喚魔法|Shōkan Mahō}} is the action ability for the [[Summoner (Tactics Advance)|Summoner]] in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''.
